title: Reconcile complete source bindings for the connected verification caller
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Supplies a complete source-binding reconciliation for the connected caller in [PR #6867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6867), exact head `319ea1c5f4097ef87cc0b037327f26374e93e54d`. The argument joins the actual bootstrap/private loader, constructors, complete recipes, scientific caller, native view/property observer, error owners and automatic retention consumers under their original prospective premises. No additional semantic patch was needed.

This is a completed **source-audit archive**, prepared Ready for review. It contains the complete argument, full machine-readable review certificate and exact source/context mapping. It is independently generated AI source review with a root source/criterion audit; human review, proof-kernel acceptance, current-host/native qualification and scientific execution are separate. Original predicates, 52 helper identities, 65 contexts and independent oracles remain unchanged. No κ or measured speedup is claimed.

The review corrects an input error: the normal and optimized recipes intentionally select different pinned scientific drivers. It also distinguishes the instrumented diagnostic baseline from the required original primary. Neither a historical anchor nor provisional STOP/UNKNOWN observations supplies the later fresh primary comparison or successful CLOSE.

## Task and overlap

Explicit follow-up to [the original investigation and maintained goal/PR map](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321#issuecomment-6713710045). Scope is unchanged: reconcile the complete current source graph. The all-six freeze, actual consumer-contract and independent stage/installation-order criteria retain their own acceptance requirements.

Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. Owning implementation: #6867 at `319ea1c5f4097ef87cc0b037327f26374e93e54d`. Its [#6866](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6866) retained-child construction, [#6864](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6864) factory/cwd repairs, [#6863](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6863) connected caller and [#6830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6830) compiler/native proof are preserved. Exact inspected heads and concrete reuse decisions, including outside contributions, are in `RELATED-WORK.json`. Bounded searches do not establish global novelty.

Added value over those contributions is the whole-current-graph composition and literal source-criterion dependency audit, rather than another isolated repair. The 66 external source leaves remain explicitly pinned public dependencies; they are not silently assumed to be ancestors of this archive.

## Validation

- Completed Pro source review and root assessment of the full argument; original source work closed within its fixed one-hour window.
- JSON parsing and exact byte/hash readback: all 66 current local selected leaves match the public subjects inspected by the reviewer. The 1,201,989-byte full certificate is preserved unchanged, SHA256 `1ed6b0e4775d8d21dacbade5536cfbf7464592edd81004395cb7b3817f22508a`.
- Certificate applicability mapping retains 528 overlay relations, 65 contexts and 100 original command records. These identity checks instantiate the unchanged accepted scientific subject; counts/hashes are not themselves a semantics proof.
- Seven UTF-8 archive files have exact byte/SHA256/Git-blob identities in the saved publication manifest. `INTEGRITY.json` pins the other six files. The README describes independent acquisition and byte checking from immutable public URLs.
- No unchanged controls, archive decompression, archived target import, native compilation, target launch, full comparison or successful CLOSE was run. No new guarded policy debit or budget. Physical preparation/review/publication and historical gaps remain `OPEN_NOT_ZERO`.

No replay hook is registered for this inert audit. Hosted planning/onboarding and any skipped replay must be reported separately from source or scientific qualification. Runtime fit, actual T1/T2/currentness and ownership, complete controls, fresh original-primary transfer and successful CLOSE remain open.

## Credit

Preserves the original Clear1nsight investigation and linked predecessor implementation/proof contributions and notices. Prepared for Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro assistance. New material is Apache-2.0. AI review is not a maintainer endorsement.

## Open next questions

1. Independently accept the exact all-six freeze, genuine cache/full-caller and retention consumer contract, and complete stage/installation order. Start from the certificate's final tuple and dependency order; changed selections need fresh reconciliation. No automatic cross-item credit.
2. Qualify actual native/currentness/role inputs and the whole original/new control union under a complete admitted resource envelope. This archive authorizes no execution.
3. Use [#6847](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6847) and [#6837](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6837) for the genuine [#6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029) primary operation; preserve fresh same-input typed transfer and sample order.
4. Adopt [#6762](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6762) through the distinct later closer after actual target completion, including loader/role/profile consumers and independent outcome review.
